05 / GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we
make a move.

Video, web, or the complete picture.
Here’s how we approach it.

Can we work on just video or just a website?+

Absolutely. Start with the discipline you need. If your project involves both, we align the creative direction, message, and customer journey from the beginning.

What does a combined project look like?+

A campaign and its destination, developed together. For example, a product film and a matching product page, or short-form launch ads and a dedicated landing page. The scope depends on your goals.

How are pricing and timelines decided?+

We define deliverables, complexity, revision rounds, and your launch date before agreeing on a scope. A short ad edit and an immersive website require different levels of production; your proposal should reflect the actual work.

Can you use our existing brand and assets?+

Yes. Share your brand guidelines, website, existing footage, and campaign materials. We can work within an established identity or discuss the creative direction a new project needs.

What should we prepare for the first conversation?+

A short description of your business, your audience, the outcome you want, and your approximate budget and deadline. Use the project planner below to put those essentials in one place.
